resources.string: Welcome to your first mesibo app
This demo shows you how to add messaging, voice and video calls to your apps in just a few lines of code.
To use this demo, log in to the mesibo console, create two users, set their tokens in MainActivity, and run the app on two phones.
Refer to the tutorial for instructions:
You have not set the tokens in the code yet. Set USER1_TOKEN and USER2_TOKEN in MainActivity, and run the app again.
